tagline: Ek chhota sa binary handshake, phir kisi bhi TCP connection ke liye relay.
description: SOCKS5 ek general-purpose proxy hai. Client SOCKS server se connect karta hai, login method chunta hai, login karta hai, aur server se kisi host aur port se connect karne ko kehta hai. Ek line ke reply ke baad server bas bytes dono taraf copy karta rehta hai, isliye ye sirf HTTP nahi, har TCP protocol ke liye kaam karta hai.

normal.name: Login karo aur name se connect karo
normal.summary: curl --socks5-hostname SOCKS5 server pe login karta hai aur uske through example.com fetch karta hai.

steps.title: Greeting
steps.desc: Version 5, do login methods offer kiye
steps.detail: Port 1080 pe connect hone ke baad client teen se chaar bytes bhejta hai: version 5, kitne login methods pata hain, aur unki list. Yahan wo 0x00 (no login) aur 0x02 (username aur password) offer karta hai.

steps.title: Method selection
steps.detail: Server sirf do bytes mein jawab deta hai: version 5 aur jo method usne chuna. Is server ko login chahiye, isliye wo 0x02 chunta hai.

quiz.q: Client ko ab agla kya bhejna hoga?
options: Kuch nahi; tunnel khul chuka hai
quiz.why: Method 0x02 ka matlab hai ki kisi bhi command se pehle username/password exchange (RFC 1929) hona zaroori hai.

steps.title: Username aur password
steps.detail: Client version byte 1 bhejta hai, phir username aur password, har ek ke aage ek-byte ki length ke saath. Server unhe check karke 01 00 reply karta hai: success. Dhyan do ki password bilkul encrypted nahi hai.

quiz.q: Username "danish" hai. Uske theek pehle wala byte kya hai?
quiz.why: Har string ke aage ek-byte ka length prefix hota hai, aur "danish" 6 bytes ka hai.

steps.title: CONNECT example.com:80
steps.desc: Name se, isliye DNS proxy karta hai
steps.detail: Client server se example.com port 80 pe CONNECT karne ko kehta hai, IP ki jagah domain name (address type 3) deke. SOCKS server khud name lookup karta hai aur apna TCP connection kholta hai. Reply batata hai ki success hua aur server kaunsa address aur port use kar raha hai.

quiz.q: Aap example.com ko laptop ki jagah proxy se resolve kyun karwana chahoge?
options: Taaki aapka local network aur DNS server ye na dekh sake ki aap kaunsi site visit kar rahe ho
SOCKS IP addresses carry nahi kar sakta
quiz.why: Request mein domain name hone se DNS lookup proxy pe hota hai, isliye laptop se koi DNS query leak nahi hoti.

steps.title: Data flows
steps.desc: SOCKS server bas bytes copy karta hai
steps.detail: Ab se SOCKS kuch add nahi karta. Laptop connection mein ek normal HTTP request bhejta hai; SOCKS server use example.com tak copy karta hai aur reply wapas copy karta hai. SSH, SMTP ya kisi bhi TCP protocol ke liye aise hi kaam karega.

outro.title: Dumb pipe, smart start
outro.text: Chhe chhote binary messages (greeting, method choice, login, login result, connect, reply) relay set up karte hain. Uske baad SOCKS dikhta hi nahi. Ye aapka address website se chhupata hai, lekin encryption add nahi karta, isliye andar TLS rakho ya ise SSH pe chalao (ssh -D).

bad-login.name: Galat password
bad-login.summary: Login fail ho jata hai aur SOCKS server connection band kar deta hai.

steps.title: Greeting aur method
steps.detail: Client connect karta hai, no-auth aur username/password offer karta hai, aur server username/password chunta hai.

steps.title: Galat password
steps.detail: Is baar password galat type hua hai. Server 01 01 reply karta hai. RFC 1929 kehta hai ki failure ke baad server ko connection band karna hi hoga, isliye wo turant FIN bhejta hai. curl batata hai ki SOCKS5 login fail ho gaya.
facts: User was rejected by the SOCKS5 server

quiz.q: Kya client usi connection pe doosra password try kar sakta hai?
options: Nahi, failure ke baad server ko connection band karna hi padta hai
quiz.why: RFC 1929 ke hisaab se failed login ke baad server ko connection close karna hota hai. Client ko dobara connect karke shuru se start karna padta hai.

outro.title: Login fail, connection band
outro.text: Failed RFC 1929 login connection khatam kar deta hai; CONNECT kabhi try hi nahi hota. Password internet pe clear text mein gaya, isliye eavesdropper ko galat aur sahi password dono barabar dikhte hain.
facts: SOCKS ko SSH ya TLS mein wrap karo
